title: Petra and the Harbor
author: Ulyana Okafor
blurb: Paloma Kavanagh, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
